LANDING AUDIT: Read full approved plan:202611/sized_pomodoro_close.md, epic and all four child beads/notes, bob-cli commits 070d2aac/135793bf/5f361c5a and Mac 8cc25b3, plus current grammar, staging, reset, JSON/human output, docs, tests, and Mac presentation/alias source. chain_scope=front is implemented through the shared position predicate; decision_record=no honored, no memory/version/changelog edits. Sizing preserves clock metadata, refuses before batch commit, and passes C to all three ordinary close planners and summaries; 2x0 bypasses reset. Remaining work: Mac view always renders timingText plus sizeChipText (secondary tint), instead of one session-tinted size chip; accessibilitySummary appends raw chip text instead of the blocks/delta sentence. Mac docs and generator have no sized rows; refusal/same-size/comma-guard fixtures/tests missing. Rust promised coverage is incomplete: no sized two-meeting C classification or explicit selection test; equivalence only asserts range, 2x0 wrongly permits in_progress, composition only checks that JSON exists, no new-task close, several negative assertions are conditional or missing. A medium tale will finish only these gaps and close this epic itself. No code changes or new Rust verification run in this audit.
